channel.title: Customer Wars
channel.desc: In Maryland, a delivery worker's sharp turn catches his co-worker off guard; at the Tampa airport, a passenger who's upset at missing her flight is confronted by police; in Las Vegas, a self-proclaimed "cart narc" publicly roasts shoppers who leave carts astray; at a drive-thru safari in Troutman, North Carolina, a family is surrounded by some hungry beasts; in the Maldives, ferry passengers are forced to make a terrible choice when their vessel begins to sink.
